envelope.description: Search, ruleset, org, auth, status, codespace, config and extension families

body.title: Search, ruleset, org, auth, status, codespace, config and extension families
body.summary: Add gh_search with its per-group flags and fixed --json fields, gh_ruleset, gh_org, gh_auth, gh_status, gh_codespace, gh_config and gh_extension, with sc3 conversion for auth status, ruleset list and status, the deterministic config parser, and the codespace create preview notice with --default-permissions always passed; register them and carry their unit tests.
acceptanceChecks: search qualifier expressions such as >100 and 5..20 pass through unchanged
codespace create always passes --default-permissions, has no defaultPermissions field and its preview states the permissions are accepted
auth logout and switch need hostname and user, and every codespace op except list and create needs codespace

tests.name: gh-search-inputs.test.ts: comparison and range expressions pass through unchanged for comments, interactions, reactions, followers, forks, stars, size and the date qualifiers
gh-family-tools.test.ts: codespace create always passes --default-permissions and has no defaultPermissions field
gh-convert-text.test.ts: auth status and ruleset list keyValues are checked against the raw text
gh-inputs.test.ts: auth logout and switch need hostname and user; codespace ops need codespace except list and create; delete needs codespace and offers no all
